correctness.rationale: An exact 12-vertex icosahedral graph is rectified to the canonical 30-vertex, 60-edge icosidodecahedral graph; shortest-path diameter 5. Independent enumeration returns face vectors K2=(30,180,380,330,102), K3=(30,300,1340,3150,4374,3800,2100,720,140,12). Whole-Hasse acyclic matchings: at K2, 510 pairs and a vertex+triangle critical; at K3, 7981 pairs and vertex+two triangles+tetrahedron critical. Independent signed integer Morse differential (1,-1) is primitive, hence K3~S2. A coherent 56-triangle sphere fundamental cycle on 84 edges has zero signed boundary and evaluates primitively in integral Morse coordinates (1) at K2 and (-1,0) at K3; thus K2→K3 has degree ±1 and is a homotopy equivalence. K1 is wedge of 11 circles by 20 disjoint triangle collapses; exactly fifteen disjoint diameter-five antipodal pairs force K4=join of fifteen S0=S14; K5 full simplex. All real scales use inclusive integer thresholds. The checker performs exhaustive finite verification, not statistical extrapolation.
